_comment: The roster as data, so the page and the tools read one list rather than
two that drift. `seat` is whether this species can take a seat in the
game; `station` is whether it has something to show on the stage at all.
The mouse is station-only on purpose -- see ROSTER.md.
`export` records WHICH VERSION an export came from. A connectome under
active proofreading is not one dataset, it is a series of them, and an
export with no version on it cannot be reproduced.

species.name: Fruit fly
species.blocker: the best-known male volume is MANC, a ventral nerve cord, not a brain; a human has to log in to neuPrint and confirm what exists

species.name: Roundworm
species.note: gap junctions are not chemical synapses; a LIF core that treats them alike is wrong invisibly

species.name: Zebrafish
species.note: vglut2a and gad1b labels give each cell a sign, which is what makes a LIF model possible at all

species.name: Mouse
species.why_no_seat: a cubic millimetre of visual cortex has no motor output, because it is not a whole brain
species.functional: ~75,000 pyramidal neurons with recorded responses to visual stimuli
